content.user_title: Organize project files and logs safely
content.value_statement: Large planning files, session logs, and local state can become difficult to review and maintain. This skill organizes defined project files, creates backups, and reports the resulting changes.
actual_capabilities: Archives completed Plans.md tasks while excluding active task markers.
Splits older session-log.md entries into month-based archive files.
Lists or deletes retained log files older than a configured age.
Trims agent trace files to the most recent 1,000 lines.
Creates a timestamped Plans.md backup before editing large files.
Reports before-and-after line counts and affected file counts.
limitations: It only covers the documented Plans.md, session log, logs, and state workflows.
It does not automatically edit decisions.md, patterns.md, CHANGELOG.md, or files under .git.
State JSON cleanup requires inspecting the current file structure before implementing filters.
Deletion and archival outcomes depend on file dates, task markers, and user-selected thresholds.

use_cases.title: Archive completed plans
use_cases.description: Move old completed tasks into a clearly grouped archive after confirming active tasks remain untouched.

use_cases.title: Reduce session-log size
use_cases.description: Split older session records into monthly files while keeping recent entries in the working log.

use_cases.title: Control local log growth
use_cases.description: Preview and clean old log files or trim large trace files using defined retention rules.

prompt_templates.title: Preview plan cleanup
prompt_templates.prompt: Run maintenance plans with --dry-run and show which completed tasks qualify for archiving.

prompt_templates.title: Split session history
prompt_templates.prompt: Run maintenance session-log. Keep the most recent 30 days and report each monthly archive file.

prompt_templates.title: Review old logs
prompt_templates.prompt: Run maintenance logs with --dry-run using a 45-day retention period. Do not delete files yet.

prompt_templates.title: Run scoped maintenance
prompt_templates.prompt: Run maintenance all. Preserve active task markers, create required backups, stop on errors, and provide a before-and-after summary.

output: Plans.md is below the configured line limit.
Six completed tasks were found, and none meet the archive age threshold.

output_examples.input: Split the session log and report the result.
output: Older entries were organized into monthly archive files.
The report lists line-count changes and archive destinations.
The report lists the number of deleted log files.
Remaining log files are counted after cleanup.
The task stops and reports an error if a stage fails.

best_practices: Use --dry-run before deleting or moving files.
Confirm important planning details are recorded before archiving completed tasks.
Review the before-and-after report and keep backups until the result is accepted.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for feature implementation, code review, or releases.
Do not archive tasks marked as active or awaiting work.
Do not extend cleanup to unrelated directories without explicit user confirmation.

faq.question: What files can this skill maintain?
faq.answer: It handles Plans.md, session-log.md, files under .claude/logs, and selected state files.

faq.question: Can I preview changes first?
faq.answer: Yes. Add --dry-run to list proposed changes without performing them.

faq.question: Does it delete active tasks?
faq.answer: No. Tasks with documented active or pending markers are excluded from archiving.

faq.question: Does it create backups?
faq.answer: It directs a timestamped backup before editing files that exceed 200 lines.

faq.question: Can it edit project history files?
faq.answer: No. It does not automatically edit decisions.md, patterns.md, CHANGELOG.md, or .git files.

faq.question: What happens if one maintenance stage fails?
faq.answer: The all workflow stops and reports the error rather than continuing silently.
